notes:
Stage: mid-market evaluation. Product: customer-facing analytics + in-app help bot + doc search. Short notes and call snippets below.

- Summary: Larkspur wants a path: quick launch on Hosted API for velocity, then move to Dedicated once SLA + unit-cost line up. Primary drivers: lower per-query cost for high-volume search and tighter response-time guarantees for in-app agent.
- Workload profile: mixture of short chat turns (avg tokens 50-120) and embeddings-based doc search (queries/sec spiky: 80-250 during business hours). Target p50 response latency <= 300ms for chat, throughput target 150-200 QPS for search index lookups.
- Cost sensitivity: strong. Finance asked for modeled unit economics showing hosted vs dedicated at 50k, 200k, 1M monthly requests. VP said: "Need predictable committed cost before Q3 budget sign-off."
- Security: must be SOC2-ready, SSO (SAML) integration mandatory, audit logs and KMS support required. Data residency: US only for now.
- POC plan agreed: 2-week hosted API POC to validate latency and correctness -> short dedicated pilot on representative traffic (staging) to produce real unit-cost numbers.
- Cost-optimization workshop: scheduled as critical next step. Workshop objectives: produce concrete batching and caching guidance, evaluate quantization profiles for their transformer encoder used for embeddings/reranking, model warm/cold cost tradeoffs, and compute a per-request cost sheet. Attendees: Redwood AE + SE, Larkspur Eng (2), Product (1), Finance (1).
- Technical asks from Eng: demo of prefix/KV cache saving for conversational flows, how to configure batch windows to preserve latency SLO, typical quantization quality delta (FP16 -> int8/4bit) for models in Redwood catalog.
- Quote from Head of Eng: "If you can show 2-3x cost savings on inference without visible regressions in NDCG / usefulness we're in."
- Docs & links: pricing deck + security FAQ in drive (drive://redwood/pricing-larkspur-deck-v2.pdf, drive://redwood/security-faq-larkspur-2026-03-01.md). Gmail thread id for procurement conversations: gmail-CAFE1234-232. Jira escalations: AIENG-412 for embedding flattening bug, SECQ-77 for KMS key policy question.
- Next deliverables: run cost-optimization workshop (week of 2026-03-15), deliver quantization POC and unit-cost spreadsheet by 2026-03-22, follow-up exec pricing review wk of 2026-03-29.
- Blockers: procurement wants committed ARR before Dedicated spin-up; legal awaiting SOC2 evidence and data residency confirmation.

CRM shorthand / misc: "prefers short turnaround and clear $/req metrics; demo went well on hosted, key decision hinges on committed cost math and security sign-off."
notes_short: Mid-market SaaS evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated. POC agreed. Cost-optimization workshop to quantify batching, caching, and quantization savings. Security questionnaire and procurement approvals are main blockers.
